featured.title: The DOL Just Launched Its Biggest H-1B Fraud Probe. Dozens of Subpoenas Are Already Out
featured.excerpt: The Labor Department's Inspector General announced a sweeping investigation into H-1B and PERM visa abuse, the administration's first major fraud case targeting the programs that bring hundreds of thousands of Indian workers to America.
featured.image_caption: The Frances Perkins Building, headquarters of the U.S. Department of Labor in Washington, D.C.
featured.nri_angle: Indian nationals hold roughly 70 percent of all H-1B visas and dominate PERM green card filings — any fraud crackdown on these programs disproportionately affects the Indian diaspora's path to work and residency in America.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

news.title: The DOJ Just Threatened to Prosecute Election Officials Over Voter Rolls. Naturalized Indian Americans Could Pay the Price.
news.excerpt: Chandigarh-born Harmeet Dhillon sent criminal warnings to all 50 states. The database her department wants states to use has already flagged eligible citizens for removal.

news.nri_angle: The DOJ's voter roll purge campaign relies on databases known to wrongly flag naturalized citizens — putting millions of Indian Americans who earned their citizenship at risk of disenfranchisement ahead of the 2026 midterms.

news.nri_angle: Prosecutors say the Bishnoi gang created a 'climate of fear' among Indian diaspora communities in the US and Canada through targeted violence and extortion — including a $5 million demand against a victim in California.

nri-world.excerpt: Modi's July 10 visit to New Zealand will be the first by an Indian PM in four decades. For a diaspora that now makes up six per cent of the country and generates $350 million in GDP, it is less a diplomatic event than a recognition long overdue.

nri-world.nri_angle: New Zealand's Indian community — now 350,000 strong and six per cent of the population — awaits the first visit by an Indian PM in 40 years, navigating between diplomatic warmth and tightening immigration rules.

nri-world.title: India Just Received a Record $145 Billion From Its Diaspora. For the First Time, America Sent the Most.

nri-world.nri_angle: America is now the single largest source of remittances to India, overtaking the Gulf — a data-driven confirmation of the diaspora's shift from blue-collar Gulf workers to white-collar US professionals.

nri-world.title: She Left Kerala at Six. Now Nithya Raman Wants to Run America's Second-Largest City.

nri-world.nri_angle: Raman's journey from a Malayali immigrant family in Louisiana to the doorstep of LA's top job encapsulates the expanding arc of Indian American political ambition — no longer limited to state legislatures and Congress, but now reaching for executive power in the country's biggest cities.

nri-world.title: India's Real Estate Just Had Its Best Half-Year in Six Years. Here Is What NRIs Need to Know.

nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs account for roughly 19% of Indian property purchases. Its free programming in Surrey's Punjabi Market and partnership with Indo-Canadian artists make it a direct expression of diaspora cultural identity and cross-generational connection.

nri-world.title: America's Fastest-Growing Diaspora Is Getting Old. The Safety Net Barely Exists.
nri-world.excerpt: In Queens, an AI-powered food pantry is feeding 1,500 South Asian seniors a year. In Irvine, a new wellness centre serves elders who speak no English. Across the country, a crisis is building that the community has only begun to name.
nri-world.image_caption: America's Indian diaspora is aging rapidly, and community support systems for elderly immigrants remain scarce (Wikimedia Commons)
nri-world.nri_angle: The aging of the first large wave of Indian immigrants to the US and the growing phenomenon of 'parent visas' — elderly parents brought over to help with grandchildren — has created a uniquely diaspora elder care crisis. Language barriers, cultural isolation, unfamiliarity with American social services, and the shame associated with admitting family cannot cope are all distinctly NRI dimensions of the problem.

nri-world.title: India's Central Bank Is Paying NRIs Up to Seven Per Cent to Park Their Dollars at Home. Here Is the Catch.

nri-world.nri_angle: Directly impacts NRI savings strategy — overseas Indians can now earn 5.5-7% on dollar deposits in India with zero currency risk, a significant premium over US savings accounts. The scheme specifically targets Gulf and US-based NRIs.

technology.excerpt: The EU's General Court dismissed every Apple challenge to the Digital Markets Act. With India's own antitrust case heating up, the ruling could reshape how the App Store works for a billion users.
technology.image_caption: Apple CEO Tim Cook, whose company lost its challenge against the EU's Digital Markets Act
technology.nri_angle: Indian app developers pay Apple's 30% commission on every in-app purchase; the EU ruling could set precedent for India's CCI case that would benefit the thousands of Indian iOS developers and NRI investors holding Apple stock.

technology.title: India Just Switched On Its Third Chip Plant in Five Months. The Target: Five Billion Chips a Year.

technology.image_caption: A silicon wafer with semiconductor chips — the kind of component India's new OSAT facilities are designed to assemble and test
technology.nri_angle: NRIs tracking India's semiconductor ambitions now have a third plant to watch — and the sector is creating a new class of manufacturing jobs that could reshape return-to-India career calculations for chip engineers in the US and Europe.

technology.title: HCLTech Just Landed a $1.14 Billion AI Deal With a European Giant. It's the Biggest Win in Three Years.

technology.image_caption: HCLTech's Noida SEZ campus — headquarters of the IT services firm that just signed its largest new deal since 2023
technology.nri_angle: For the tens of thousands of Indian engineers employed by HCLTech in the US and Europe, the deal signals that AI-led transformation — not legacy maintenance — is becoming the firm's growth engine, potentially reshaping the kinds of roles and skills the company hires for.

technology.title: An AI Agent Just Ran a Full Ransomware Attack on Its Own. The Cybersecurity World Is Rattled.
technology.excerpt: Sysdig researchers documented JADEPUFFER, the first known case of agentic ransomware — an LLM that breached a server, stole credentials, encrypted data, and wrote its own ransom note in 31 seconds flat.
technology.image_caption: A ransomware attack warning — AI-powered cybersecurity threats are escalating (Wikimedia Commons)
technology.nri_angle: Indian cybersecurity professionals — who form a significant share of the global infosec workforce — are now confronting a threat landscape where AI agents can execute attacks faster than human defenders can respond, raising urgent questions about AI-assisted defence tools and India's own CERT-In preparedness.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Beijing Is Building an Iron Curtain Around Its AI. Indian Startups Should Be Worried.
technology.excerpt: Chinese authorities are in talks with Alibaba, ByteDance and Z.ai about restricting overseas access to the country's most advanced AI models — a move that could squeeze hundreds of Indian companies built on cheap Chinese AI.
technology.nri_angle: Indian-origin tech workers and founders who built products on cheap Chinese AI face sudden cost pressure; India's sovereign AI efforts are years behind, leaving the diaspora-linked ecosystem exposed on both the American and Chinese fronts.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Meta Just Gave 500 Million Indians an AI Image Generator. Here's What Muse Image Does.
technology.excerpt: Muse Image, the first image-generation model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, is rolling out across Instagram Stories and WhatsApp — putting AI-powered visual creation inside apps that dominate India's digital life.
technology.image_caption: Meta's headquarters in Menlo Park, California — the company has launched its Muse AI image generator for Indian users (Wikimedia Commons)
technology.nri_angle: Indian-origin engineers at Meta built Muse Image for the company's largest non-US market; NRI investors watching Meta's $115B AI spend should note the new subscription revenue stream targeting India's 500M WhatsApp users.

lifestyle-health.title: A Single 'Polypill' Cut Heart Failure Hospitalizations by 60 Percent in a Landmark Trial — and It Could Reshape How Millions Manage the Disease
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The POLY-HF trial, led by Indian-American cardiologist Dr. Ambarish Pandey, found that combining three heart failure drugs into one daily pill dramatically improved adherence and survival — a breakthrough with outsized implications for South Asians, who face the world's highest burden of cardiovascular disease.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: AIIMS New Delhi — a landmark polypill trial has shown that combining four heart failure drugs into one tablet cut hospitalizations by 60 percent
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians bear 60% of the world's heart disease burden and face higher cardiovascular risk by age 45 — a simplified polypill strategy could transform medication compliance for diaspora families managing chronic conditions across borders.

lifestyle-health.title: Half of All Americans Now Feel Lonely at Least Once a Week — and the Diaspora Is Not Immune
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A surge in isolation is driving real health consequences, from depression to heart disease. For NRIs who left dense social networks behind, the crisis cuts deeper.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A solitary figure, reflecting the growing isolation crisis
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Indian immigrants face elevated loneliness risks after leaving dense family and community networks; older NRIs joining children abroad are especially vulnerable.
